note: Library and hardware combinations that broke a model load in this repository's own runs, as ov.doctor() checks them. Each entry names the files where the failure and its fix are recorded. upstream is null where no upstream issue has been linked yet; nothing here is copied from an issue tracker. 'when' lists the conditions that must all hold: installed (distributions present), below / at_least (installed version), models / model_prefix / loaders (the model asked about), gpu_capability_below (no visible GPU at or above that CUDA compute capability).

issues.seen: Kaggle image with torchao 0.10 preinstalled, peft 0.19; every notebook since uninstalls torchao
